TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.CUSTOMER_NAME_URL;

WITH TEMP_SRC AS (
SELECT BANK_ID, CUST_ID, SOL_ID, SOL_DESC, ORGKEY, NAME, Customer_Type, isActive, isLatest, BNK_CODE, SOURCE_CODE, FILE_NAME,
ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY, NAME, SOL_ID, SOL_DESC, CUSTOMER_TYPE ORDER BY CUST_ID) RNK
FROM (
SELECT GAM_BANK_ID BANK_ID, AAS_CUST_ID CUST_ID, DF_SOL_ID SOL_ID, BRANCH_NAME SOL_DESC, ORGKEY ORGKEY, CUSTOMER_NAME NAME, Customer_Type, CUST_isActive isActive, CUST_isLatest isLatest, CUST_BNK_CODE BNK_CODE, CUST_SOURCE_CODE SOURCE_CODE, CUST_FILE_NAME FILE_NAME
FROM EDS.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER DEP 
WHERE GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01' 
UNION ALL
SELECT GAM_BANK_ID BANK_ID, AAS_CUST_ID CUST_ID, SOL_ID SOL_ID, BRANCH_NAME SOL_DESC, ORGKEY ORGKEY, CUSTOMER_NAME NAME, Customer_Type, CUST_isActive isActive, CUST_isLatest isLatest, CUST_BNK_CODE BNK_CODE, CUST_SOURCE_CODE SOURCE_CODE, CUST_FILE_NAME FILE_NAME
FROM EDS.LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER LNS
WHERE GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01' 
) A
)

INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_NAME_URL
(CustomerID,
CustomerName,
CustomerNameID,
CustomerType,
Branch,
URL,
isActive,
isLatest,
BNK_CODE,
SOURCE_CODE,
FILE_NAME,
insert_dttm)   
SELECT ORGKEY AS CustomerID
               , Name AS CustomerName
               , CONCAT(Name, ' - ', ORGKEY) AS CustomerNameID
               , COALESCE(Customer_Type , 'NA') AS Customer_Type
               , CONCAT(SOL_ID, ' - ', SOL_DESC) AS Branch
               , CONCAT ('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/172214a5-2625-4222-bf18-328238309387/reports/5bbee878-4207-4d06-b51d-f84f77c078ab/ReportSectionb3bac1535211098d00e1?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''', ORGKEY, '''') URL
               , isActive
               , isLatest
               , BNK_CODE
               , SOURCE_CODE
               , FILE_NAME
               , SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' insert_dttm
FROM TEMP_SRC
WHERE RNK = 1
